world.text: Jin–Song Wars: A Song fleet, equiped with trebuchets that launched incendiary bombs, defeated Jin ships in a naval engagement on the Yangtze river.
William III unilaterally revised the constitution of Luxembourg, greatly expanding his powers as grand duke.
World War II: Australian forces began the Battle of Wareo by conducting clearing operations between Bonga and North Hill.

President Lyndon B. Johnson delivered the "Let Us Continue" speech, in which he advocated for civil-rights legislation and national cohesion, to a joint session of the U.S. Congress five days after the assassination of John F. Kennedy.
Astronomers announced the detection of sodium in the atmosphere of the extrasolar planet HD 209458 b, the first exoplanet atmosphere to be measured.
